'''Jonathan Grubb''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished tenth in [[2025 Retro League Event 3]].<ref name="p1439242" /> His GEMP handle is '''bennyjet''',<ref name="rl2026handles">[https://swccg.com/snapshots/email/2026-10-11-retro-league-gemp-handles.pdf Email from Michael Adamson to 2026 Online Retro League participants, "Re: 2026 Online Retro League - Event 4 Classic No V modified - Welcome and Week 1 Pairings", 11 October 2026] (Retro League participants list: player name / GEMP handle / forum name; provided by Bill). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013204005/https://swccg.com/snapshots/email/2026-10-11-retro-league-gemp-handles.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> and he is listed as "Jonathan G" in the 2025 Retro GEMPC standings. He also played the [[2025 Ninth Annual GEMPC]] and finished '''#81''' at the [[2025 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]].<ref name="talaga2025" /><ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-05-9th-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2025/ 2025 Ninth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020233558/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2025-05-9th-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2025.html Internet Archive].</ref>
